title: Meta threat alert, relayed through the FBI, brings Paraguayan police and psychologists to a bullied 17-year-old who praised the Uvalde shooter
summary: Meta flagged a Paraguayan teen's post praising the Uvalde shooter; the FBI relayed it and police, prosecutors and psychologists intervened.
account: On Thursday 26 May 2022, two days after the Uvalde school shooting, Paraguay's Policía Nacional and Ministerio Público received an alert, from Meta's platform and from the FBI office in Buenos Aires, that a user in Paraguay had tagged the shooter, called himself his 'fan' and said something similar could happen in Paraguay with more victims. Comisario Diosnel Alarcón's cybercrime department identified the Instagram profile as a 17-year-old in the 'zona central' who lived with a relative and had been treated as a bullying victim. Police, prosecutors, the children's defender and psychologists visited the home, recommended urgent psychological support, and also visited a friend who knew of the posts. No weapon or plan was reported.
purpose: Meta's content-detection and law-enforcement referral process exists to find posts that threaten violence or self-harm and to pass credible threats to the authorities of the user's country; flagging this post and alerting the police was that purpose.
system: Meta (Facebook/Instagram) violence-threat detection and law-enforcement referral process
domain: Online safety and threat referral to law enforcement
taxonomy_note: Loose fit; a threat of a copycat shooting was checked and the minor given psychological support, but no weapon or plan was found and the detection is not shown to be automated.

ratings.reason: The 17-year-old, a bullying victim living with a relative, was seen by prosecutors' psychologists, who recommended urgent support ('contención'); the sources report no coercive outcome beyond a planned review of his phone.

A public statement that a school shooting could be repeated in Paraguay was checked within a day, after local media had reported threats in schools; police said many such alerts prove to be jokes, so no prevented harm is shown.

ai_role.statement: Officials said the network detected the comment, classified it as dangerous and reported it to the FBI and to a 24/7 channel shared by prosecutors and the cybercrime police; Alarcón also spoke of corroborating 'datos de analítica artificial' before the visit. No source states that the flag was automated. Meta documents that its technology proactively detects most violating content before anyone reports it, but its referrals to law enforcement also pass through human review. Identifying the user, the home visit and the psychological support were the work of Paraguayan police, prosecutors and the child-protection office.

produced_by: A platform practice of reporting threats of violence to law enforcement in the user's country, here through the FBI's Buenos Aires office and a 24/7 police-prosecutor channel
A cybercrime unit able to identify an account holder from the platform's primary data within hours
A welfare rather than punitive response, with prosecutors, the children's defender and psychologists attending
must_hold: The referral must carry enough account data to identify a real person; police said many flagged profiles are fake or jokes
The response must stay proportionate for a minor; the Monitor flags rights, psychological and reputational risks to the child
The platform's detection and referral thresholds, which are not public for this case, must stay in place for the alert to recur
